_purpose: Record the read-only production and Smart+ source checks used by the shared-social hierarchy QA comparison.

claims.scope: Current shared-social production snapshot and TikTok ADIF Smart+ creative history
claims.summary: Production has a unique full-grain key, and the latest Smart+ creative records have complete campaign and ad-group IDs.

dependencies.fingerprint_query: SELECT CONCAT(CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING), '|', CAST(MAX(date_day) AS STRING), '|', CAST(MAX(IFNULL(spend, 0)) AS STRING), '|', CAST(SUM(impressions) AS STRING)) AS fingerprint FROM `looker-studio-pro-452620.repo_stg.stg__olipop__crossplatform_raw_tbl`

SELECT CONCAT(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT creative_id) AS STRING), '|', CAST(MAX(_fivetran_synced) AS STRING), '|', CAST(COUNTIF(campaign_automation_type = 'UPGRADED_SMART_PLUS_CREATIVE' AND (campaign_id IS NULL OR adgroup_id IS NULL)) AS STRING)) AS fingerprint FROM `giant-spoon-299605.tiktok_ads_adif.creative_history`
